exemplars.name: Steps Row
exemplars.description: Eyebrow + headline + a three-card row: entrance stagger on a fixed rhythm, arrows leading each card, everything rise-and-settle.

exemplars.name: Browser Walkthrough
exemplars.description: Fake screencast on the kit: BrowserWindow types the URL, loads, reveals the captured page (assets.page still), scrolls to the proof; one caption pill per beat. Chrome is NEVER hand-drawn.

exemplars.name: Code Chip
exemplars.description: Bottom-band file chip: clean enter AND exit, container first then staggered content lines, dark interior independent of brand.

exemplars.name: Badge Pill
exemplars.description: A single punctuation mark over footage: pill rises in, tick stamps with overshoot, whole thing exits before the end.

exemplars.name: Word Pop Title
exemplars.description: WORDS-driven: each word pops on its spoken start, the word being spoken carries the accent, the line never reflows.

exemplars.name: Accent Underline Title
exemplars.description: WORDS-driven phrase reveal: words fade in on their own starts; the payoff word takes the accent and an underline wipe on its cue.
